definition_en: Nomadic or tribal peoples united under a supreme ruler (Xiongnu, Göktürks)
definition_zh: 游牧或部落民族在最高统治者之下联合（如匈奴、突厥）

definition_en: Hereditary monarch with unchecked supreme authority
definition_zh: 世袭君主掌握不受制约的最高权力

definition_en: Monarch bound by a constitution, with a separate head of government
definition_zh: 君主受宪法约束，另设政府首脑

definition_en: A nominal sovereign alongside an effective military ruler (Kamakura shogunate)
definition_zh: 名义君主与掌握实权的军事统治者并存（如镰仓幕府）

definition_en: Monarch chosen by a body of electors (HRE, Poland–Lithuania)
definition_zh: 君主由选举团体选出（如神圣罗马帝国、波兰-立陶宛）

definition_en: Monarch whose authority runs through hereditary vassal lords
definition_zh: 君主权力通过世袭封臣贵族层层行使

definition_en: Shares the British monarch; represented locally by a Governor-General
definition_zh: 与英国共奉同一君主，由总督在当地代表君主

definition_en: A single legal ruling party holds a monopoly on power
definition_zh: 唯一合法的执政党垄断政权

definition_en: A one-party state ruled by a communist party
definition_zh: 由共产党执政的一党制国家

definition_en: Interim authority pending a constitutional settlement
definition_zh: 宪政安排确定前的过渡性政权

definition_en: Citizen assembly as the sovereign body (Athens)
definition_zh: 公民大会为最高权力机构（如雅典）
由集体行政委员会执政（如瑞士）

definition_en: Rule by elected magistrates drawn from a narrow elite (Roman Republic, Venice, Genoa)
definition_zh: 由狭小精英阶层中选出的官员执政（如罗马共和国、威尼斯、热那亚）

definition_en: Head of government responsible to parliament; separate head of state
definition_zh: 政府首脑对议会负责，另设国家元首

definition_en: President is both head of state and head of government
definition_zh: 总统兼任国家元首和政府首脑

definition_en: Executive president with a constitutionally subordinate PM (France, Fifth Republic)
definition_zh: 总统掌握行政权，总理在宪法上从属于总统（如法兰西第五共和国）

definition_en: A republic in which a religious leader holds supreme authority (Islamic Republic of Iran)
definition_zh: 宗教领袖掌握最高权力的共和国（如伊朗伊斯兰共和国）

definition_en: Supreme authority held by a religious office (Papal States, Ganden Phodrang)
definition_zh: 最高权力由宗教职位掌握（如教皇国、甘丹颇章）
